MonoBrowser 0.6.3

- The vertical tab sidebar can sit on the right edge of the window (Settings → Browsing → Tab bar side, also offered during onboarding); compact mode reveals it from the right edge
- "Never sleep this tab" in the tab menu: the tab is excluded from automatic sleeping, "Sleep other tabs" and the RAM limiter, and is marked with a lightning bolt
- With the sidebar on the right, the space and action buttons at its bottom line up with the window edge
- Fixed menus opened from the compact-mode sidebar appearing on the wrong side of the window
- Updated to Electron 45

Downloads:
- Windows: `MonoBrowser-Setup-0.6.3.exe`
- Linux: `MonoBrowser-0.6.3-x86_64.AppImage`
